dramatic_truth: The old trail stops being adventurous scenery when an active slide nearly kills Greg and emergency external magic produces a real but bounded field result.
performance: Greg hears warning, makes one bad scouting decision, retreats correctly, deflects a head-line stone into his shoulder, records the magic as attempt 139 without measurement and then critiques his own terrain judgment before continuing conditionally.
screenplay: Split-oak route; recent slide evidence; active release; retreat behind channel wall; emergency stone deflection; shoulder injury inventory; rooted bypass; Sleeping Stone shelter and seep observations.
prose_comparison: The clipped cadence belongs to physical sequencing and threat. Recomposition would blur terrain, timing and the distinction between luck, magic and judgment.

dramatic_truth: After the slide Greg has to prove continuing is still an honest conditional decision rather than momentum or pride.
performance: He inventories shoulder function, route alternatives and overnight change, advances only where evidence supports it and treats every new landmark as uncertain comparison to local story memory.
screenplay: Morning injury check; route beyond Sleeping Stone; landmark verification and pathfinding; each continuation threshold is re-earned rather than assumed.
prose_comparison: Repeated body and route checks are the mechanism preventing adventure momentum from becoming recklessness.

dramatic_truth: Greg crosses the route's decisive water/terrain boundary and learns that reaching the source area yields evidence rather than the clean answer the story shape seems to promise.
performance: He manages the crossing conservatively, samples/observes under contract rules and refuses to inflate proximity into mechanism or source certainty.
screenplay: Morning stream state; careful crossing; destination evidence gathered; return burden becomes carrying an answer that remains incomplete.
prose_comparison: The crossing details earn their space because success changes custody and knowledge, not just location.

dramatic_truth: Once Greg has the sample, the return trip becomes a courier problem where preserving chain and wording matters more than the physical weight he carries.
performance: He protects the sample, keeps observations separate from interpretation and treats the return route as a new problem rather than replaying the outbound journey.
screenplay: Sample secured; route retraced under changed body/weather state; custody grows more important than exploration; settlement return approaches.
prose_comparison: Outbound and return share landmarks but have opposite dramatic jobs: discovery versus custody.

dramatic_truth: Back among people, Greg becomes witness to his own field work and must let contract, local memory and district procedure coexist without making any one of them the whole truth.
performance: He reports the slide, sample, emergency magic and route observations without heroic inflation, then lets other stakeholders argue what the evidence means.
screenplay: Mabel morning; field report and sample handoff; multiple parties bring different interpretations; Greg owns only what he observed and did.
prose_comparison: The debrief is the necessary state conversion from private experience to shared evidence.

dramatic_truth: Recovery after the field job lets Greg seek the next direction without treating survival as a mandate to stop or proof he should keep escalating.
performance: He sleeps, inventories body and money, closes the old contract emotionally as well as procedurally and chooses east only after the previous task is actually over.
screenplay: Late wake; recovery and settlement loose ends; options reopen; Greg chooses the next road without quest continuation logic.
prose_comparison: The quiet reset prevents consecutive adventures from collapsing into one endless escalation curve.

dramatic_truth: Bracken Vale prospecting tests whether Greg can turn newly acquired route credibility into better questions rather than simply more jobs of the same type.
performance: He scans work and opportunity, asks what is actually verifiable and walks away with a more valuable question instead of forcing a treasure/work payoff.
screenplay: Cart to Bracken Vale; local opportunities and claims inspected; weak leads discarded; one better question survives.
prose_comparison: Prospecting here is epistemic and economic filtering, distinct from Merehook market prospecting.

dramatic_truth: Greg deliberately crosses beyond the comfortable route marker because curiosity has become sufficient motivation, then the world answers with real unmanaged risk.
performance: He acknowledges that the choice is his, not assignment pressure, explores beyond Marker Seven and responds to danger without retroactively pretending he had been forced there.
screenplay: Past Marker Seven; unfamiliar terrain; exploratory observations; conditions turn dangerous enough to demand survival judgment.
prose_comparison: The chapter makes agency accountable. Its exploratory repetitions establish that he knowingly chose the exposure.

dramatic_truth: After another physical cost, Greg reframes progression as architecture: deciding what future capability he is actually building rather than training every weakness at once.
performance: He inventories shoulder and knee honestly, separates damage from baseline and turns scattered ambitions into an explicit construction problem with tomorrow accountable to today's priorities.
screenplay: Morning injury/body state; competing magic, mobility, money and travel goals surfaced; Greg chooses a build direction rather than a mood.
prose_comparison: The reflective systems language is character progression, not generic optimization exposition.

dramatic_truth: Greg calibrates money against a thirty-copper operating target, turning ten copper from 'safe' into evidence that his earning ceiling, not merely spending restraint, is the current bottleneck.
performance: He writes explicit thresholds, tests them against body, travel and opportunity needs and allows the target to reorganize choices without becoming a permanent doctrine.
screenplay: Ten-copper state; thirty-copper target written; constraints compared; Greg identifies the next leverage problem and prepares to act on it.
prose_comparison: The numerical reflection changes the meaning of the same amount of money and is a genuine state transition.
